title: Kubernetes: workloads
description: Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets and Jobs in each environment: whether they have the pods they want, containers that cannot start or ran out of memory, and the CPU and memory they use against their requests and limits.

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.description: An environment is a Kubernetes cluster, or any machines, that send to this Grafana under one name: the cluster label Alloy sets, which is the name given in the Telopi portal.

list.name: workload
list.label: Workload
list.description: A Deployment, StatefulSet or DaemonSet. Its pods are those whose names start with its name.

query.query: query_result(max by (workload) (label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.+)") or label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.+)") or label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.+)")))

list.definition: query_result(max by (workload) (label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.+)") or label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.+)") or label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.+)")))

panels.title: Workloads
panels.description: Deployments, StatefulSets and DaemonSets, and those with fewer pods available than they want.

targets.expr: (count(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", deployment=~"$workload"} ) or vector(0)) + (count(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", statefulset=~"$workload"} ) or vector(0)) + (count(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", daemonset=~"$workload"} ) or vector(0))

(count(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", deployment=~"$workload"} > kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", deployment=~"$workload"}) or vector(0)) + (count(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", statefulset=~"$workload"} > kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", statefulset=~"$workload"}) or vector(0)) + (count(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", daemonset=~"$workload"} > kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", daemonset=~"$workload"}) or vector(0))

panels.title: Cannot start
panels.description: Containers crash-looping, or waiting for an image, a secret or a config.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", reason=~"CrashLoopBackOff|ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull|CreateContainerConfigError|CreateContainerError|InvalidImageName"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Restarts, last hour
panels.description: Container restarts in the last hour.

targets.expr: sum(increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?"}[1h])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Out of memory
panels.description: Containers whose last run was killed for using more memory than their limit (OOMKilled).

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", reason="OOMKilled"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed jobs
panels.description: Jobs that failed and are still in the cluster.

targets.expr: sum(kube_job_failed{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", job_name=~"($workload)(-.*)?", condition="true"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Used
panels.description: Cores and memory (working set) the containers use. Needs cAdvisor's metrics.

targets.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", container!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))
sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", container!="", image!=""})

panels.title: Workloads
panels.description: Each Deployment, StatefulSet and DaemonSet: the pods it wants and those available.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace, kind, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", deployment=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.+)"), "kind", "Deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", statefulset=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.+)"), "kind", "StatefulSet", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", daemonset=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.+)"), "kind", "DaemonSet", "", ""))

max by (cluster, namespace, kind, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", deployment=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.+)"), "kind", "Deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", statefulset=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.+)"), "kind", "StatefulSet", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", daemonset=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.+)"), "kind", "DaemonSet", "", ""))

max by (cluster, namespace, kind, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_spec_replicas{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", deployment=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.+)"), "kind", "Deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_replicas{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", statefulset=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.+)"), "kind", "StatefulSet", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_desired_number_scheduled{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", daemonset=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.+)"), "kind", "DaemonSet", "", "")) - max by (cluster, namespace, kind, workload) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_deployment_status_replicas_available{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", deployment=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "deployment", "(.+)"), "kind", "Deployment", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_statefulset_status_replicas_ready{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", statefulset=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "statefulset", "(.+)"), "kind", "StatefulSet", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(kube_daemonset_status_number_available{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", daemonset=~"$workload"}, "workload", "$1", "daemonset", "(.+)"), "kind", "DaemonSet", "", ""))

panels.title: Containers that need a look
panels.description: Waiting now: why a container cannot start. Last stopped: why its last run ended, out of memory (OOMKilled) or with an error.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container, state, reason) (label_replace(kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", reason=~"CrashLoopBackOff|ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull|CreateContainerConfigError|CreateContainerError|InvalidImageName"} > 0, "state", "Waiting now", "", "") or label_replace(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", reason=~"OOMKilled|Error|ContainerCannotRun"} > 0, "state", "Last stopped", "", ""))
sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", container!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: CPU: used, requested, limit
panels.description: All selected pods together, in cores. Above the limit a container is throttled.

targets.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", container!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", resource="cpu"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", phase=~"Pending|Running"}))

sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", resource="cpu"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", phase=~"Pending|Running"}))

panels.title: Memory used, by pod
panels.description: Each pod's working set, what counts against its limit.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", container!="", image!=""})

panels.title: Memory: used, requested, limit
panels.description: All selected pods together. A container over its memory limit is killed (OOMKilled).

targets.expr: sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", container!="", image!=""})

sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", resource="memory"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", phase=~"Pending|Running"}))

sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", resource="memory"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left () max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", phase=~"Pending|Running"}))

panels.title: CPU throttled
panels.description: The share of time slices in which a pod's containers wanted more CPU than their limit allows. Over 25% slows it noticeably.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", container!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?", container!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

defaults.noValue: Nothing throttled, or no cAdvisor data

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0

panels.title: Received, by pod
panels.description: Bits a second into each pod. Needs cAdvisor's metrics.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8

panels.title: Sent, by pod
panels.description: Bits a second out of each pod. Needs cAdvisor's metrics.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"($workload)(-.*)?"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8

panels.title: Jobs
panels.description: Each Job still in the cluster, and how its pods ended. A CronJob's runs are Jobs named after it.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace, job_name) (kube_job_status_active{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", job_name=~"($workload)(-.*)?"})
max by (cluster, namespace, job_name) (kube_job_status_succeeded{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", job_name=~"($workload)(-.*)?"})
max by (cluster, namespace, job_name) (kube_job_status_failed{cluster=~"$environment", namespace=~"$namespace", job_name=~"($workload)(-.*)?"})
